name: yakyard-lock
description: End-to-end encryption for Yakyard's locked conversations: Olm and Megolm (vodozemac, WebAssembly) in the browser, with recovery keys, key backup and device approval.
author: QVINTA Ltd

scripts.build:wasm: cd crypto && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir ../dist --out-name yakyard-crypto target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/yakyard_crypto.wasm
